title: GenerationReady
description: Content was written and is handed over in full. The one result that carries the work itself rather than a reference to it: the asking system has no database of generations to read it back from. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

template.description: Which template it was written from.

session_id.description: The working session it was made in.

overall_score.description: What the pipeline thought of its own output. Absent when nothing scored it, which is not the same as a score of zero.

source_assets.description: The assets it was written from, by id.
